specs.Compatible Devices: All Type C to USB A

features: Universal Compatibility for Effortless Connectivity: Easily connect USB-C devices, including smartphones, tablets, external drives, and more, to standard USB-A ports on laptops, desktops, gaming consoles, and car systems without any compatibility issues.
Blazing Fast 5Gbps Data Transfer with USB 3.0: Experience ultra-fast file transfers, whether moving large videos, documents, or backups, ensuring a seamless and efficient workflow.
Fast & Reliable Charging up to 15W: Supports up to 15W power delivery, allowing quick and stable charging for your USB-C devices without compromising on performance.

Premium Aluminium Alloy Build for Maximum Durability: Crafted from high-quality aluminium alloy, this adapter is built to withstand daily wear and tear while offering superior heat resistance and a sleek metallic finish.

Compact & Ultra-Portable Design: With a super-mini size (29×15×7 mm) and lightweight build (only 5g), this adapter is easy to carry in your pocket, wallet, or laptop bag—perfect for travel or everyday use.
Plug & Play Convenience: No Drivers Required – Enjoy instant connectivity without the need for additional software or installations, making it incredibly easy to use for all users.
